name: Time
description: The current date and time here or in any city or time zone, with daylight saving; time zone conversion; date arithmetic with working days, ages, week numbers and weekdays; month calendars; countdowns; a check of this computer's clock against the internet; and public holidays. Use when an answer depends on the date, the time, a time zone or a date calculation.

network.info: Only when asked: checks this computer's clock against an internet clock, and reads public holidays

functions.name: time_now
functions.description: The current date, time, day of the week and UTC offset, on this computer or in any time zone or city, with the zone's abbreviation and daylight saving. Set check_clock to compare this computer's clock with an internet clock (needs the network permission).

timezone.description: A time zone: an IANA name such as Asia/Kolkata, a city in one such as Tokyo, UTC, or an offset such as +05:30. Default: this computer

check_clock.description: Also check this computer's clock against the internet

functions.name: time_convert
functions.description: Convert a time from one time zone to one or more others, following daylight saving on that date. Says when the date changes, and when a time does not exist or happens twice because the clocks change.

time.description: 18:30, 6:30 pm, 2026-11-07 18:30, or now. A time alone is today in from_timezone

from_timezone.description: A time zone: an IANA name such as Asia/Kolkata, a city in one such as Tokyo, UTC, or an offset such as +05:30. Default: this computer

to_timezone.description: The zones to convert to, up to 20

functions.name: date_calc
functions.description: Date arithmetic. From a date (default today): add years, months, weeks, days or working days (Monday to Friday; public holidays are not skipped); find the next given weekday; or, with until, count the days, weeks, working days, and the years, months and days between (an age). Every date comes with its weekday, ISO week and day of the year.

date.description: The start date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today. Default: today

add_years.description: Years to add; negative goes back

add_months.description: Months to add; negative goes back. A day past the month's end becomes its last day

add_weeks.description: Weeks to add; negative goes back

add_days.description: Days to add; negative goes back

add_working_days.description: Working days (Monday to Friday) to add; negative goes back

next_weekday.description: A day of the week, such as monday: the first one after date

until.description: An end date as YYYY-MM-DD, or today, to count the time between

timezone.description: Whose today to use. Default: this computer

functions.name: calendar
functions.description: A month's calendar as a text grid, with its number of days, working days, first and last weekday, and today's date when it is this month.

month.description: The month as YYYY-MM, or today for this month

functions.name: countdown
functions.description: The days, hours, minutes and seconds from now until a date or a date and time, or since it when it has passed.

timezone.description: The zone the target is in. Default: this computer

functions.name: holidays
functions.description: A country's public holidays for a year, and the next one from today, from the Nager.Date service (needs the network permission). Not every country is covered.

country.description: The two-letter ISO 3166 code, such as US, DE or GB
